user_statement: J'approuve D1 à D12 selon tes recommandations

D1.decision: P5-PROTO-2 approved as basis for freeze

D2.decision: option (a): 1200 s wall ceiling with pre-registered fallback ladder L1-L3, 30 s per command, 0 EUR
D2.effect: budget approved for P5 when execution is authorised; P5 ledger not yet created; P0-P4 remainder 178.675 s not used

D4.decision: recommendation = install is a distinct decision that does not authorise fits
D4.effect: scikit-learn install NOT authorised by this approval; explicit authorisation still required; P5b blocked until then

D5.decision: option (a): P5b reserved evaluation 30 structures x 4 parents x 2 twins

D6.decision: reinforcement truth values approved as written (R1 p_pub {0.4..0.9} independent; R2 marginal 0.5, rho 0.5 per pool; all-or-nothing; open loop)

D7.decision: twin precheck threshold 25 staff-min^2 (5 min RMS), K=3, train partition approved

D8.decision: early_stopping=False, fixed parameters of section 6.4, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1

D9.decision: structure-level one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% harm bound, threshold 10%

D10.decision: resource decomposition descriptive only, no extra cost

D11.decision: execution authorisations separate and in order: (i) implementation and pilot P5.0-P5.2, (ii) P5a reserved evaluation, (iii) P5b fits and evaluation
D11.effect: none of (i)-(iii) is granted by this approval

D12.decision: cockpit out of P5; independent React replay remains a separate product gate

still_required_before_any_execution: explicit authorisation (i) implementation and pilot P5.0-P5.2
explicit authorisation of scikit-learn install (D4) before P5b
explicit authorisation (iii) P5b fits and evaluation
